method: Read the four frozen rendered main texts and authored drafts, original comparison siblings, and additional related full pages. integrationRule: These are proposed replacement subjects, not score changes or permission to erase baseline findings. Do not retain the old example's provider, description, scope prompts or unrelated guide labels around the new brief.
